edit.ability:
Starts with a Heavy Ion, Burst Laser II, Artemis Missiles, and Pike Beam.
May not be in defense mode.
When this is damaged, the opponent may either reduce this creature's defense by half the amount of damage dealt or deal that amount of damage to one of the weapon minions.
(1CD) Choose to repair, either restoring a weapon minion to full HP or replenish 1.5 DEF lost from this ability (cannot exceed base DEF).
(2 points) Refresh the previous ability.
